company: Nevada State University
title: Campus Infrastructure Senior Manager
options: NSU - Dawson Campus [undeclared]
description:
[under: Job Description] The Campus Infrastructure Senior Manager oversees project planning, programming, design, procurement, construction, occupancy, and project closeout activities while coordinating with architects, engineers, consultants, contractors, regulatory agencies, campus stakeholders, and executive leadership.
[under: Primary Responsibilities] - Manage architects, engineers, consultants, contractors, testing agencies, and other professional service providers.
[under: Primary Responsibilities] - Evaluate infrastructure conditions and recommend funding priorities based on risk, operational impact, and lifecycle considerations.
[under: Primary Responsibilities] - Provide institutional oversight of outsourced facilities management services through performance-based contract administration rather than day-to-day operational direction.
[under: Primary Responsibilities] - Monitor contractor performance, preventive maintenance compliance, operational responsiveness, key performance indicators (KPIs), and service quality to ensure contractual obligations and university standards are met.
[under: Primary Responsibilities] - Collaborate with contractor leadership to jointly evaluate facility conditions, prioritize deferred maintenance needs, and develop long-term capital renewal strategies using asset condition data and lifecycle best practices.
[under: Primary Responsibilities] - Establish performance expectations and accountability measures while empowering the contractor to manage daily maintenance operations, staffing, scheduling, and technical execution.
[under: Primary Responsibilities] - Review and validate contractor recommendations for deferred maintenance, major repairs, and capital renewal projects to ensure alignment with university priorities, available funding, and risk mitigation objectives.
[under: Required Qualifications] - Bachelor’s degree in planning, architecture, construction management, engineering, facilities management, or a related discipline for an accredited college or university recognized by the United States Department of Education and/or the Council on Higher Education Accreditation.
[under: Required Qualifications] - Demonstrated experience managing architects, engineers, consultants, contractors, and professional service agreements.
[under: Required Qualifications] - Ability to provide written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex material to diverse audiences to establish a culture of collaboration, consensus-based solution approach and positive attitude.
[under: Required Qualifications] - Ability to update project management procedures, forms and related documentation, and other departmental materials within the office and online.
[under: Required Qualifications] - Eligibility to work in the United States without sponsorship (Nevada State does not sponsor employment-related visas).
[under: Preferred Qualifications] - Master’s degree in planning, architecture, construction management, facilities management, engineering, or a related discipline for an accredited college or university recognized by the United States Department of Education and/or the Council on Higher Education Accreditation.
[under: Note to Applicant] This position may require a criminal background check to be conducted on the candidate(s) selected for hire.
[under: Note to Applicant] Nevada State University does not currently sponsor Visas, all applicants must be eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship.

title: Data Scientist
options: Multiple Locations [onsite]
description:
[under: Tools for success] This role requires the willingness and ability to be onsite at the Inspire11 or client location depending on project needs to maximize in-person collaboration and build stronger relationships.
[under: Tools for success] Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. at the time of application and throughout the duration of employment.
# U.S. Compensation & Benefits
[under: Bonuses] We may allow employees in Sales, Recruiting, or Leadership to earn periodic bonuses based on sales, revenue, client-specific or practice-specific targets.
[under: Bonuses] All such target-based bonuses are calculated based on the Company and an individual’s periodic performance and will only be awarded if: (a) the employee is meeting performance expectations and is an employee in good standing of the Company; (b) the target is met; and (c) the Company’s current financial performance and market conditions permit the bonus to be paid out.
[under: Bonuses] If the Company decides that annual bonuses may be awarded, then the Leadership Team, Market Directors, and Managing Directors will work together to grant annual bonuses to employees in good standing based on the same factors discussed in the previous paragraph while also considering employees’ diligence, performance, expertise, skill, judgment, and experience.
[under: Bonuses] To be eligible to participate in this annual bonus pool, an employee must be hired by no later than October 1st of the preceding year.
[under: Bonuses] Annual bonuses and merit increases may be prorated based on hire date.
[under: Bonuses] Employees eligible for target-based periodic bonuses are not eligible to participate in the annual bonus pool.
[under: Options or Other Equity in Inspire11] The Company also has a newer program that grants options annually to high-performing employees based on their performance reviews, their managers’ recommendation, and leadership approval.
[under: Other Benefits] - Regular gifts of Inspire11 clothes, office items, and swag.
[under: Disclaimer] This document applies only to the United States and to Inspire11 LLC, not our worldwide partners.
[under: Disclaimer] Inspire11 reserves the right to change the benefits offered to employees in accordance with applicable law based on business needs, market conditions, and financial stability.
